INSERT INTO agents (token_id, hostname, ip, os, agent_version, log_files)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT(token_id, hostname)
        DO UPDATE SET
            ip = excluded.ip,
            os = excluded.os,
            agent_version = excluded.agent_version,
            log_files = excluded.log_files,
            last_seen_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now')
